segments.arabic:
١١٤٠٨- صفية بنت الخطاب
أخت «١» عمر.
تقدم نسبها في ترجمة عمر، ذكرها الدّار الدّارقطنيّ في كتاب «الإخوة» «٢» وقال: تزوّجها سفيان بن عبد الأسد، فولدت له الأسود.
وقد تقدم في قدامة بن مظعون أنه تزوّجها، واستدركها أبو علي الغساني، وقال:
ذكرها أبو عمر في قدامة ولم يفردها.
segments.english:
11408 — Safiyya bint al-Khattab

The sister(1) of 'Umar.

Her lineage was given previously in the entry on 'Umar. Al-Daraqutni [the Arabic reads al-Dar al-Daraqutni] mentioned her in the Book of Siblings(2) and said: Sufyan ibn 'Abd al-Asad married her, and she bore him al-Aswad.

It was stated previously, in the entry on Qudama ibn Maz'un, that he married her. Abu 'Ali al-Ghassani included her as a supplementary entry and said: “Abu 'Umar mentioned her under Qudama but did not give her a separate entry.”

unresolved.explanation: The canonical Arabic contains the unexplained duplication al-Dar al-Daraqutni. Neither the supplied Urdu pages nor the collateral entries reproduce this clause, so they cannot establish whether the first al-Dar is a printing or copying error. The final translation normalizes the identifiable authority as al-Daraqutni while explicitly recording the canonical reading.
